categories.name: My Ideas

categories.name: Develop
categories.blurb: Shape the story and the look before anything gets scheduled.

categories.name: Prep

tools.name: Specialist Research Hub
tools.desc: Find what you already know about your specialist role, where the gaps are, and how to close them: rate yourself concept by concept, then keep notes, references and evidence.

tools.name: Ideas
tools.desc: Catch an idea in seconds, typed or spoken, then grow it: develop it, outline it, write a scene, branch it, and graduate it into a project when it's ready.

tools.name: Idea workspace
tools.desc: The Script Development Tool, working on one idea from the Ideas page.

tools.name: Script Development Tool
tools.desc: Scaffolded scriptwriting: build characters, settings and structure, then write in screenplay format with saved drafts.

tools.name: Script Coverage & Feedback
tools.desc: Read a script PDF: map its structure against Save the Cat, 3-Act or Scaffolded, leave comments and page summaries, and write a full coverage report.

tools.name: Mood Board
tools.desc: Collect stills, clips and music for the film's look and sound, tick which department each one is for, and export a PDF.

tools.name: Colour Palette Studio
tools.desc: Pull a 3–10 colour palette from any still, check it against 60/30/10, and build a reference deck that blends many stills into one look.

tools.name: Pre-Production Pipeline
tools.desc: A department-by-department roadmap from idea to shoot-ready, with trackable tasks, filters and an editable glossary.

tools.name: Script Breakdown
tools.desc: Tag cast, props, SFX, wardrobe and more straight onto your script PDF, leave labelled comments for the crew beside it, then export category lists, scene-by-scene breakdowns and a colour-coded script.

tools.name: Script Lining Tool
tools.desc: Upload a script PDF and draw tramlines to map shot coverage, with zig-zags for off-screen lines and notes per shot.

tools.name: Film Budget Builder
tools.desc: Build a top-sheet budget department by department, from line items or by allocating money first, with contingency, then track actual spending against the plan.

tools.name: Casting Tracker
tools.desc: Cast every role: write breakdowns, track auditionees from submission to booked, score auditions and chemistry reads, and check availability and fees.

tools.name: Talent Release Forms
tools.desc: Make a release form for every performer, with a parent or guardian section for under-18s and a group sign-in sheet for extras. Print them to sign on set, or save each one as a PDF to sign digitally.

tools.name: Location Recce
tools.desc: Recce every location: print a field sheet to fill in on site, then write up access, power, sound, light and safety, add photos, and compare candidates.

tools.name: Location Agreements
tools.desc: Make a location agreement for every place you film, with the owner's details, dates, house rules and sign-off, plus an optional before-and-after condition check. Print them to sign on the day.

tools.name: Shot List Builder
tools.desc: Plan every shot day by day with custom columns, sunrise and sunset times, breaks and company moves. Track it live on the day.

tools.name: Blocking Planner
tools.desc: Top-down floor plans for actor and camera blocking: rooms, props, movement paths and animated keyframes.

tools.name: Lighting Plan Studio
tools.desc: Draw lighting diagrams from a full library of fixtures and modifiers, with shoot info and a kit list.

tools.name: False Colour Studio
tools.desc: Plan exposure with false colour: load stills, check levels and contrast ratios, compare frames side by side and export a PDF.

tools.name: Production Schedule Builder
tools.desc: Build a stripboard-style shoot schedule with shoot days, cast legend, locations and a day-out-of-days.

tools.name: Risk Assessment Builder
tools.desc: Work through hazards, controls, emergency, welfare and sign-off while the risk assessment builds alongside.

tools.name: Call Sheet Builder
tools.desc: Fill in production, location, scenes, weather and catering details while the call sheet builds alongside.

tools.name: Task Board
tools.desc: Keep on top of pre-production: what needs doing, who's doing it and when it's due, as a board, a calendar or a timeline.

tools.name: Production Pipeline
tools.desc: The shoot day from crew call to wrap: set-up, the repeating shot cycle and tear down, with guidance for every department.

tools.name: Script Supervisor's Log
tools.desc: Print the script supervisor's paperwork for a shoot day: a daily progress report, a take log with the day's shots ready to fill in, and a continuity sheet for every scene. Bring the basics in from the schedule and shot list.

tools.name: Camera Report
tools.desc: Print the camera department's paperwork for a shoot day: a camera report for each camera with the day's shots ready to log, and a card and data log for handing media to the DIT. Bring the basics in from the schedule and shot list.

tools.name: Post-Production Pipeline
tools.desc: A phase-by-phase roadmap from offload to final export in DaVinci Resolve, with trackable tasks, research, Resolve basics and an editable glossary.

tools.name: Lighting Pattern Lab
tools.desc: Learn classic portrait lighting on a 3D head: Rembrandt, loop, butterfly, split, broad and short. Move the key light and see real soft-shadow falloff.

tools.name: Lighting Ratio Lab
tools.desc: Plan lighting ratios on a lit frame. Set key, fill, backlight and background in stops, read the ratios by meter or spot, and build a deck of looks to compare and export.

tools.name: Exposure Lab
tools.desc: Explore falloff, collimation and hard vs soft light from arm's length to a kilometre, with an exposure triangle, ND and a live camera preview.

tools.name: Depth of Field Lab
tools.desc: Move a camera through a 3D set and see exactly what's sharp: focal length, aperture, focus distance and sensor size.

tools.name: Colour Temperature Lab
tools.desc: See how the colour of light and your camera's white balance work together. Move each along the Kelvin scale and watch a scene warm, cool and come back to neutral.

tools.name: Mic Placement Lab
tools.desc: Learn how distance, pickup pattern and gain decide what your mic records. Place the mic, choose what you're recording, and see and hear the signal against the noise.

tools.name: Spectrum Analysis Lab
tools.desc: See a sound split into its frequencies. Pick out the peaks, listen to them on their own, and hear how different mics would change the same sound.
